standard_prerequisites: the arrow property rig-etale for continuous homomorphisms of Noetherian adic rings (lemma-rig-etale-continuous of the same chapter) and the cancellation property of Formal Spaces, Remark formal-spaces-remark-permanence-variant-Noetherian
the exact sequence of completed naive cotangent complexes for A -> B -> C (lemma-exact-sequence-NL of the same chapter)
the rig-etale criterion in terms of annihilation of the cohomology of NL^wedge by powers of an ideal of definition (lemma-equivalent-with-artin of the same chapter)
core_obligations: Prove that the property rig-etale on arrows of WAdm^Noeth has the cancellation property: if A -> C and A -> B are rig-etale then B -> C is rig-etale
proof_roadmap: Choose an ideal of definition I of A inducing the topologies on B and C, and write the six-term exact sequence relating the cohomology of NL^wedge_{B/A} tensor C, NL^wedge_{C/A} and NL^wedge_{C/B}.

The rig-etale hypotheses give c >= 0 with a^c killing NL^wedge_{B/A} in D(B) and NL^wedge_{C/A} in D(C) for all a in I, so H^0(NL^wedge_{B/A}) tensor C, H^0(NL^wedge_{C/A}) and H^{-1}(NL^wedge_{C/A}) are annihilated by a^c.
The exact sequence then shows a^{2c} kills H^0 and H^{-1} of NL^wedge_{C/B}, and the equivalence lemma concludes that C is rig-etale over (B, IB).
difficulty_reason: H3: a homological-algebra chase through the cotangent exact sequence converting two annihilation statements into the one needed for the quotient arrow.
